canopy.note: this survey has no vegetation labels, so trees are found from multiple-return pulses; touching crowns merge and some shrubs or scaffolding may slip in

scenarios.name: Plant 200 street trees
scenarios.why: Trees on the sunniest walkway spots, 8 m apart
scenarios.cost_basis: ASSUMED: 6000 rupees per tree with three years of care, 3500 rupees per square metre of new footpath. Not quotes.
scenarios.assumptions: each new tree is 8.0 m tall with a 3.0 m crown; trees at least 8.0 m apart
